title: Season prep equipment purchases (balls, tees, cage)
description: Continue season-prep purchasing: balls, helmets, catcher's gear, bats, tees, and batting cage supplies.

title: Field improvements / infield mix / batting cage rebuild
description: Review Douglass field improvements: infield mix and batting cage rebuild.

title: Abuse Awareness Training resets (Oct 1)
description: Little League's Abuse Awareness / Safe Sport training resets October 1. All board members and volunteers must re-complete it for the new fiscal year, even if they completed it last year or through another organization.

title: Board Abuse Awareness training compliance push
description: Following the Oct 1 reset, drive all board members to complete Abuse Awareness training and track certificates. A Safe Sport badge is required to work with players.

title: ASAP Plan & AED devices review (winter planning)
description: Update the ASAP plan and confirm AED device status as part of winter/pre-season board planning.

title: Abuse Awareness / Safe Sport compliance check
description: Verify all board members and returning volunteers have current Abuse Awareness / Safe Sport certification and Safe Sport badges before the season ramps up.

title: ASAP Plan & AED devices review (pre-season)
description: Final pre-season review of the ASAP plan and AED devices ahead of assessments, drafts, and the start of practices.

title: Abuse Awareness compliance for board members (in-season)
description: Follow up on any outstanding Abuse Awareness training for board members and volunteers so everyone on the field remains a Certified Volunteer.

title: AED devices update & CPR/Heartsaver clinic scheduling
description: Provide an in-season AED device update and schedule additional CPR / Heartsaver clinics as needed for coaches and volunteers.

title: ASAP / SAFE Plan initiation
description: Ensure the ASAP / SAFE plan is fully initiated and copies are carried by all coaches at games and practices, including completed medical release forms.

title: Financial / Treasury update at board meeting
description: Present bank and PayPal/online balances, outstanding invoices/obligations, and P&L/budget notes at the board meeting; recurring at each meeting throughout the year.

title: Registration fees set for coming season
description: Confirm registration fee schedule with the board (e.g. Juniors $150, Majors/AAA $140, AA $110, A/CP/TB $80, Sandlot add-on $20) ahead of the 1/1 registration open date.

title: Sponsorship / fundraising drive kickoff
description: Launch sponsorship letters, banners, plaques, and thank-yous; set team sponsorship level ($375-$475) and manage donor tiers (banner logo $200+, dye-sub jersey $500+, signed jersey $1,000+).

title: Uniform vendor quotes and jersey layout due
description: Finalize vendor quotes, sponsor-on-front jersey layout, girl's-cut softball fit, and the customized-jersey deadline for board review ahead of ordering.

title: Early-signup custom jersey deadline (Feb 15)
description: Early-signup incentive cutoff for customized uniforms; players registered by this date qualify for a personalized jersey.

title: Softball parent discussion group meeting (bi-weekly)
description: Recurring softball parent/board discussion group covering officer roles, coming-season scheduling and travel, field improvements, equipment, uniforms, and District/high school game opportunities. Open to all softball parents to build pathways for softball success and equitability.

title: Memorial Day parade - softball turnout
description: Confirm softball division turnout for the parade and coordinate with information officer and grounds for staging.
